purpose: Preserve the current cluster of Primary Chat / worker-autonomy ideas so later Guide/Planner work can reuse them without depending on this conversation or re-asking the human.
invariants: Primary Chat is the human interface/projection, not scheduler or acceptance authority.
POOL is normal capacity; RUN is only bounded experiment.
Chats are fungible/disposable shells; durable context must survive without finding an old chat.
No scheduler, queue, CURRENT, Guide Broker, worker family, plan authority or telemetry authority may be created in parallel.
Raw private human content must not enter the public repository.
Human inactivity is not itself a fault; only an explicit machine state requiring human action may be counted as human-boundary wait.

ideas.name: PRIMARY_CHAT_SINGLE_HUMAN_SURFACE
ideas.summary: Normal human interaction moves to Primary Chat; workers and system state return there instead of requiring this privileged conversation.

ideas.name: UNIVERSAL_GUIDE_PLANNER_COGNITIVE_BLOCK
ideas.summary: Planner role executes context -> problem -> reuse -> alternatives -> critique -> task graph -> fan-out/fan-in -> anti-human-bottleneck audit -> recovery -> capacity -> successor policy -> PLAN_READY, with P0-P4 planning depth.

ideas.name: CORRECTION_TO_REUSABLE_GATE
ideas.summary: Repeated human corrections such as 'anticipate the next bottleneck', 'parallelize real lanes', 'do not make me the courier' become reusable Planner/Guide questions or hard gates rather than remaining chat-specific advice.

ideas.name: HUMAN_ACTION_CAPACITY_WIDGET
ideas.summary: Primary Chat shows one compact state/action widget using existing liveness/frontier/capacity owners, human-idle age and exact REFILL/no-action semantics.

ideas.name: CAPACITY_BARREL_RESERVE_ALARM
ideas.summary: Reuse the existing Core/Reserve/Need gauge and exact REFILL logic; low reserve <=3 (or current equivalent) can warn visually and optionally sound locally in-browser.

ideas.name: DETERMINISTIC_STATE_LAYER
ideas.summary: Compute every state that can be derived from durable timestamps/counters without model inference, so intelligence is not spent on arithmetic or status lookup.

ideas.name: DETERMINISTIC_SITUATION_STATE_MACHINE
ideas.summary: Reduce raw signals to a small set of machine-derived situations before asking an AI to reason.

ideas.name: THREE_BLOCK_RESPONSE_PIPELINE
ideas.summary: Separate every Primary Chat response cycle into STATE_FACTS, COGNITIVE_INTERPRETATION and HUMAN_COMMUNICATION so cheap deterministic work stays cheap and model effort is reserved for judgment.

blocks.A_STATE_COMPILER: No model required: durable signals, timers, counts, deterministic state and exact available actions.
blocks.B_COGNITIVE_INTERPRETER: AI only when needed: explain what changed, diagnose bottleneck, plan, judge ambiguous evidence, choose grounded successors/reserve work.
blocks.C_HUMAN_COMMUNICATOR: Template-first: one action/no-action message; optional AI summary for complex deltas; optional derived voice/TTS after canonical text exists.

ideas.name: TEMPLATE_FIRST_NO_INTELLIGENCE_FAST_PATH
ideas.summary: Simple states such as REFILL 2, no action, projection stale, human decision required or campaign complete should render from templates with zero reasoning-model dependency.

ideas.name: INTELLIGENCE_ONLY_WHERE_IMPACTFUL
ideas.summary: Use cognition for ambiguity, planning, critique, synthesis, judge/closer, successor selection and meaningful change summaries; do not spend it recomputing known telemetry.

ideas.name: USEFUL_RESERVE_WORK_FOR_SURPLUS_CAPACITY
ideas.summary: When spare generic capacity exists, prefer grounded reserve work with a consumer: exit-audit friction mining, return integration, regression checks, stale projection reconciliation, planner-gate compliance audits, recovery debt and bounded verification. Never create filler just to occupy workers.

ideas.name: REACTIVE_HUMAN_PRIORITY
ideas.summary: A new durable human intent preempts low-value reserve work through existing portfolio priority/preemption semantics; no special human scheduler or dedicated question pool.

ideas.name: FAST_HUMAN_QUESTION_RESPONSE
ideas.summary: A bounded human question should become durable work immediately and be taken by a compatible resident/free worker with minimal dispatch latency, then fan back into Primary Chat.

ideas.name: RETURN_FANIN_JUDGE_CLOSER
ideas.summary: Multiple returns converge through validation/judge/integration/closure and successor creation without the human acting as collector.

ideas.name: APPROVAL_TO_CURRENT
ideas.summary: Visible proposal/approval is conversational projection; approved work materializes into existing CURRENT owners.

ideas.name: WAKE_CAPACITY_AUTONOMY
ideas.summary: Durable demand should yield bounded capacity request/wake through existing worker runtime; where platform cannot create a cognitive shell unattended, expose exact residual human action instead of silently stalling.

ideas.name: PRIVATE_INGRESS_E2E
ideas.summary: Private Primary Chat path must remain fail-closed and keep raw private text out of public GitHub; public CANARY remains test-only.

ideas.name: CHECKPOINT_RECOVERY_REINCARNATION
ideas.summary: Every long lane must leave durable authority/context/progress/remaining-work checkpoints so any fresh shell can continue without locating the previous chat.

ideas.name: REAL_HUMAN_MACHINE_TIME_LEDGER
ideas.summary: Record timestamps across human -> system -> worker -> visible result so real waiting and avoidable bottlenecks can be measured instead of inferred from anecdotes.

ideas.name: HUMAN_BOUNDARY_WAIT_NOT_HUMAN_ABSENCE
ideas.summary: Do not call generic human silence a bottleneck. Count human-boundary wait only from an explicit durable state where machine progress requires a specific human action until that action occurs or the boundary disappears.

ideas.name: DAILY_GROWTH_AND_AUTONOMY_METRICS
ideas.summary: Track whether Prometeo is actually requiring less human coordination while producing more consumed useful work over days.

ideas.name: REUSABLE_DATA_CONTRACT_FOR_APPS_WIDGETS
ideas.summary: Widgets/apps should consume one stable structured projection of state/timing/action instead of each recomputing worker state. This reduces duplicated intelligence and lets multiple visual/voice surfaces reuse the same facts.

ideas.name: VOICE_INPUT_AND_DERIVED_VOICE_RESPONSE
ideas.summary: Raw audio/transcription should become durable input with context; canonical text/status remains authoritative. A later communicator can generate a short voice response from the structured result without making audio an authority or blocking execution.

ideas.name: HUMAN_RETURN_SUMMARY_AFTER_IDLE
ideas.summary: When the human returns after a long idle period, show deterministic elapsed time and state plus an intelligent summary only if enough material changed; end with exactly one current action or explicit no-action.

do_not_lose: Do not infer paid GPU/RAM/CPU utilization from ChatGPT worker beacons unless an actual provider/runtime telemetry owner exposes it; measure observed worker/frontier utilization separately.
Do not let reserve work outrank fresh human intent or product-critical work.
Do not ask AI to recompute deterministic state.
Do not make the human re-find old chats or carry returns.
Do not make audio/TTS an execution dependency.
Do not count raw worker/task volume as growth; count consumed useful results and reduced human coordination.

Implement/reuse a deterministic state + time compiler feeding Primary Chat widget and downstream apps.

Add synthetic scenario harness covering all deterministic states and timing edge cases.
Project daily autonomy/time metrics from existing durable events before adding new telemetry writes where possible.
